name: M3.lugre
title: LuGre friction
summary: The LuGre dynamic friction model (Canudas de Wit, Olsson, Astrom and Lischinsky, IEEE TAC 1995): bristles of deflection z give pre-sliding displacement, the Stribeck curve and frictional lag.
equation: dz/dt = v - sigma0*|v|*z/g(v), g(v) = coulomb_friction + (breakaway_torque - coulomb_friction)*exp(-(|v|/stribeck_velocity)^stribeck_exponent); tau_r = sigma0*z + sigma1*dz/dt + sigma2*v; stribeck_exponent is 2 when absent

dt.definition: The step the simulator advances by (a stateful model integrates its state over it).

output.name: tau_r
output.definition: The resisting torque at the output: what the motor must add to move the output as the inputs say.
output.sign: The joint feels -tau_r (a resisting torque opposes motion; ripple pushes and pulls with angle).

coulomb_friction.measured_by: velocity plateaus, both directions, 6-8 speeds, each at least one rotor turn

sigma0.definition: LuGre bristle stiffness sigma0: output torque per radian of bristle deflection z.

sigma1.definition: LuGre bristle (micro-)damping sigma1: output torque per rad/s of bristle deflection rate.

sigma2.definition: LuGre viscous coefficient sigma2: output torque per rad/s of output speed (the other kinds' viscous_friction).
sigma2.measured_by: velocity plateaus, both directions, 6-8 speeds, each at least one rotor turn

stribeck_exponent.definition: Shape exponent d of the Stribeck curve in g(v); 2 when absent.

python.note: The contract's own ruler: stdlib Python, torque(terms, inputs, state, dt) -> (tau_r, state), terms in SI.

js.note: The same equation as model.py as an ES module (torque(terms, inputs, state, dt) -> {tau, state}); tests/acceptance_v2/test_amendment_2_5.py holds the two to 1e-12.

friction_solref.definition: The joint's solreffriction (timeconst, dampratio): how hard frictionloss sticks; MuJoCo's soft default creeps below about 0.4 rad/s on a light hinge.

friction_solimp.definition: The joint's solimpfriction (dmin, dmax, width, midpoint, power), every entry > 0.

mujoco.note: No native part: the plugin integrates z each step with the simulator's dt (semi-implicit, stable for any dt) and applies the whole torque.

output_speed.definition: |v|, the output speed the terms were fitted or checked across.

assumptions: One bristle state for the whole drivetrain.
Pre-sliding is fitted from small reversals; larger stiction effects outside their amplitude are extrapolated.
